newsitem.title: RUSSIA: IRKUTSKENERGO TO ISSUE $150 MLN BOND, WARBURG LEAD.
newsitem.headline: IRKUTSKENERGO TO ISSUE $150 MLN BOND, WARBURG LEAD.

text.p: Russian regional power utility AO Irkurtskenergo said on Friday it planned to issue a $150 million Eurobond by the end of 1997 and SBC Warburg would lead the issue and offer a $50 million bridge loan.
"The board of directors approved a Eurobond issue worth $150 million, SBC Warburg as lead manager," Deputy CEO Valentin Mezhevich told Reuters. "SBC also offered a $50 million bridge loan."

Irkutskenergo is located in Siberia's Irkutsk region, which also plans to issue an $80 million Eurobond early next year. Irkutskenergo is one of the rare power utilities which is independent from the national power grid Unified Energy System (UES) EESR.RTS. It sells almost 20 percent of its electricity to Russia's wholesale power market.
Currently the company is working on a project to deliver electricity to China and increase output by 3,000 Megawatts.
Irkutskenergo is one of the most widely traded companies on the Russian share market. At 1010 GMT its ordinary stock traded at $0.384 after $0.390 at Thursday's close.
